C0382.title: Shanghai's First Professional Store Closer Tao Sentenced to 5 Years for Zero-Yuan Gym Takeover and Fleecing
C0382.summary: In less than one year, Tao took over multiple poorly performing fitness institutions in Shanghai for zero yuan, defaulted on rent, utilities, and wages, and sold long-term memberships and personal-training packages through promotions, defrauding members of more than 750,000 yuan. The Hongkou District Procuratorate prosecuted the case in July 2025, and on January 29, 2026 the Hongkou District Court sentenced Tao to five years in prison and a 100,000 yuan fine for contract fraud.
